horizon.note: bearing = compass deg of the band centre, elevDeg = its bottom edge above the horizon (eye-independent: at infinity). Cells: az = cam yaw + atan((col + 0.5 - cols/2) / focalCols), el = atan((horizonRow - row - 0.5) / planeDistY); sample the model by angle fraction (nearest), tier by projected rows (hDeg * rows/deg / size.h < 0.75 -> lods.half). M1 only: the band base floats 1.0 deg up, hidden behind the east wall from every M1 viewpoint; M2 (outside) adds a hill row or elevDeg 0
